newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTO FAIRS SEES 13-15MLN KROON 97 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: ESTO FAIRS SEES 13-15MLN KROON 97 PROFIT.

text.p: Estonian Fairs said that its forecast for 1997 included turnover of 45 million kroons for 1997 and a profit of 13-15 million kroons.
The free market listed company's 1996 results were 31.3 million kroons in turnover and 6.5 million kroons profit, the company said in a statement.
The fair and exhibition company had earlier said that its first quarter 1997 net turnover was 14.5 million kroons compared to 5.5 million kroons for the same period last year.
Its profit was 5.1 million kroons in the first three months compared to 0.7 million kroons for the first quarter of 1996.
The company said that the increase in turnover in 1997 stemmed from the organisation of fairs under its own name and the increase in the number of fairs and exhibitions held.
The company also said that it started to use gas heating this year which has reduced heating costs by 120,000 kroons a month.
The company plans to complete a new 4,800 square metre exhibition hall in September with construction beginning at the end of May.
Estonian fairs is currently listed on the free market of the Tallinn Stock exhange and it has applied to the exchange to move to the main list.
